digest.component_or_area: history-strip operational script and dry-run validation
propositions: Implement a committed operational script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) to rewrite repository history, removing .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and empty commits.

Prove the rewritten branch on a fresh unfiltered --no-tags scratch clone with zero publication: commit and merge counts identical to source, tree byte-identical after dynamic re-add, target history absent except HEAD, and final pack size under 150 MB.
Validate that the script refuses to run on partial (blob:none) clones and dynamically derives the re-add file set from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded lists.
Ensure the binary fast-export stream filter correctly parses data blocks by byte length to handle adversarial commit messages that begin with M or D commands.
Verify immutability of source remote branch and protected tag throughout the dry run, and confirm that no push operations are invoked by the script.
